newsitem.title: USA: Unocal replaces 101 pct of 1996 oil & gas.
newsitem.headline: Unocal replaces 101 pct of 1996 oil & gas.

text.p: Unocal Corp said it replaced 101 percent of its net worldwide oil and gas production in 1996 as it continued its aggressive development of energy resources overseas.
The company's worldwide replacement rate excludes the impact of reserve sales, including most of Unocal's California oil and gas properties, during the year.

It said it replaced 234 percent of its foreign production on a barrel-of-oil-equivalent (BOE) basis with major oil and gas additions from new and existing fields in Thailand, Myanmar Indonesia, and Azerbaijan.
